signal: Advanced Solutions International's iMIS held the #1 G2 Leader spot in association management for the 33rd season running and acquired the CSI product suite to launch the iMIS Power Suite

email.body1:
Timothy, saw iMIS held its #1 G2 Leader spot and ASI rolled out the Power Suite after the CSI acquisition.

New products and category momentum usually mean more in-market associations and nonprofits than the strategic sales team can personally cover, and that is where deals go cold before a rep reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for ASI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Timothy, quick follow-up for ASI.

With the Power Suite expanding what iMIS can sell into, the question is usually how many meetings the strategic team needs to convert that wider TAM. Most teams find out late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ASI needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Timothy, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Timothy, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Around a new product rollout, timing is everything, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to ASI either way.
